v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Fílii Sion * exsúltent in Rege suo.
text.en: Let the children of Sion * be joyful in their king.

text.la: Quam magnificáta * sunt ópera tua, Dómine.
text.en: O Lord, * how great are thy works!

text.la: Lætábitur iustus * in Dómino et sperábit in eo.
text.en: The just shall rejoice * in the Lord, and shall hope in him.

text.la: Osténde nobis, Dómine, * lucem miseratiónum tuárum.
text.en: Show us, O Lord, * the light of thy mercies.
Let every thing that hath breath * praise the Lord.

text.la: Fratres: Qui gloriátur, in Dómino gloriétur. Non enim qui seípsum comméndat, ille probátus est; sed quem Deus comméndat.
text.en: Brothers: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord. For not he who commendeth himself, is approved, but he, whom God commendeth.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Símile est regnum cælórum * hómini negotiatóri quærénti bonas margarítas: invénta una pretiósa, dedit ómnia sua, et comparávit eam.
text.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchantman * seeking goodly pearls, who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

text.la: Deus, qui beátam Iuliánam Vírginem tuam extrémo morbo laborántem, pretióso Fílii tui Córpore mirabíliter recreáre dignátus es: concéde, quǽsumus; ut, eius intercedéntibus méritis, nos quoque eódem in mortis agóne refécti ac roboráti, ad cæléstem pátriam perducámur.
text.en: O God, Who, when thy blessed hand-maiden Juliana was lying sick unto death wast pleased in wondrous wise to comfort her with the Precious Body of thy Son, be Thou entreated for the same thy servant's sake, and grant unto us also the same Comfort in our last agony, that we may go in the strength of that Meat unto our very Fatherland, which is in heaven.

text.la: Vestri capílli cápitis omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.
text.en: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered: fear not therefore; ye are of more value than many sparrows.

v.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory:

r.en: They shall be joyful in their beds.

text.la: Deus, qui nos ánnua sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Gervásii et Protásii sollemnitáte lætíficas: concéde propítius; ut, quorum gaudémus méritis, accendámur exémplis.
text.en: O God, Who gladden us by the annual festival of Your Martyrs Gervase and Protase, grant that we may be inspired by the example of those in whose merits we rejoice.
